scripts.dev: cmd /c "start cmd /k npm run dev --workspace=apps/api && start cmd /k npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const s=path.resolve('apps/web/dist'),d=path.resolve('apps/api/public');if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});}" && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
